# Soundness: types that admit what the app really does

**Question:** does every inferred type admit every value the app produces at runtime?
<!-- generated by tools/research/sync -->
**Stands:** Counted by reader, 12 of F73's 21 witnessed losses have reader-visible repairs: F77's class-body sites 5 and String parameter keys 2, and F78's four flags 5. C1376 and C1465 still reject, and render bindings add 4 Forem losses. An independent checker proves 1,922 of F73's 4,652 narrowed rows from source and no known loss; with its proofs, and two circular hand proofs counted as unproved, at most 46.9% of the narrowings lose values at 95%. Both binding tables miss 45 reachable bindings, and older catalog gaps remain, such as `Int + Float` typed `Int` ([F80](../facts.md#f80), [F79](../facts.md#f79), [F78](../facts.md#f78), [F77](../facts.md#f77), [F76](../facts.md#f76), [F75](../facts.md#f75), [F74](../facts.md#f74), [F73](../facts.md#f73), [F72](../facts.md#f72), [F71](../facts.md#f71), [F70](../facts.md#f70), [F68](../facts.md#f68), [F69](../facts.md#f69), [F65](../facts.md#f65), [F63](../facts.md#f63), [F64](../facts.md#f64), [F61](../facts.md#f61), [F58](../facts.md#f58), [F57](../facts.md#f57), [F59](../facts.md#f59), [F60](../facts.md#f60), [F56](../facts.md#f56), [F47](../facts.md#f47), [F41](../facts.md#f41)).

## October 22 order dependence on main

Two of [F80](../facts.md#f80)'s order-dependent shapes on upstream main are also wrong in both orders: a view gets the first controller's `helper_method` type instead of its own controller's, and the first `before_action` filter's ivar write instead of the last one, which Rails renders.

## October 22 census proof checker

[F79](../facts.md#f79) proves 1,922 of F73's 4,652 narrowed rows sound from the pinned source, with an independent Prism checker that proves none of the known losses. It finds the hand proofs of M1708 and M1745 circular, which raises F73's bound from 47.3% to 49.5%; closing the proved rows brings it to 46.9%. Only proofs move this bound, and getting under 10% needs caller enumeration and returns across methods.

## October 22 remaining repairs

[F78](../facts.md#f78) repairs 6 more of F73's losing rows with four flags on top of F77, five of them only through an Unresolved arm. Counted by reader, 12 of the 21 rows have reader-visible repairs: class-body sites 5, String parameter keys 2 (M131 is an unread copy of M650) and the four flags 5. C1376 and C1465 remain, and render bindings add 4 Forem losses through an old schema-ingestion bug that drops `array: true`. The census by reader finds 14.6% of F73's narrowings unread; on reader-visible rows at most 48.0% lose values at 95%, so the bound is wide for lack of proofs.

## Why it matters

A type that drops a value the app really produces becomes wrong generated code or a wrong error. Counting `untyped` rewards exactly the rules that drop values, so no precision number means much without this check beside it.

## The check

The lab's [runtime oracle](https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse-fixpoint-lab/tree/main/oracle) records values at runtime and checks them against exported types. The historical comparison used 53 traces of small reproductions (F9). The public [`reproductions/settle_sound`](https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse-fixpoint-lab/tree/main/reproductions/settle_sound) is a 12-value check (F17). The [Discourse receipt](https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse-fixpoint-lab/blob/0bdc69712c69c6c200066fdbe84651d10694f8ab/receipts/discourse-trace-2026-10-10/README.md) adds the first public-app test trace with a fixed 28-read denominator, raw values, both arms' decisions and a rerun script (F29). The [`sound-exporter`](https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse/tree/sound-exporter/tools/sound-exporter) adapter preserves source hashes, missing selections and raw uncertainty. Replay the pinned receipt with:

```sh
git clone -b sound-exporter https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse sound-source
git -C sound-source checkout --detach 48c652873a88d8bc291df1d606ad1464f9168ae3
git clone https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse-fixpoint-lab lab
git -C lab checkout --detach 0bdc69712c69c6c200066fdbe84651d10694f8ab
python3 -B lab/receipts/discourse-trace-2026-10-10/rerun.py replay \
  --adapter sound-source/tools/sound-exporter
```

The comparison passes when the oracle rejects no value that main's types accept on the declared observations, with missing/no-slot observations and newly opaque selected coverage checked separately. S3 fails this membership gate on the recorded Discourse tests. Zero rejection remains witnessed soundness on that coverage, qualified by uncertain or unsupported components; it does not establish soundness in general. The receipt retains the unobserved read and the graph/verification limits.

Also retain the [destructuring matrix](https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse-fixpoint-lab/blob/d824c4355c7faae4b9bb4a77b25daa178a3df36c/reproductions/inference-fixtures.md#destructuring) across
receiver, iterator, and parameter shapes (F20). The proposed gate should forbid increases
in unresolved selected slots alongside checking rejections: unresolved exports accept runtime
values as unknown. The [pending-bottom fixtures](https://github.com/bunnykong/roundhouse-fixpoint-lab/blob/d824c4355c7faae4b9bb4a77b25daa178a3df36c/reproductions/inference-fixtures.md#pending-bottom)
separate pending inference from non-returning control flow (F19); their coverage is limited
to the four recorded programs. Both comparisons are [recorded attempts](../attempts.md).

## Known

- On the pinned Discourse tests, rejected hostname String snapshots witness the earlier source-level F8/F28 omission (F29). Other rejected snapshots include nil `job_id` values from direct `perform`; no isolated causal repair is attributed. Every observed value has a static slot, and the public hostname redaction preserves all decisions.
- At S3 `92844f68`, `@data` in Discourse's `app/jobs/base.rb` is typed as a hash of `Integer` values after both a `String` and an `Integer` are stored in it. The join over its `[]=` writes loses the earlier contents (F8). [#705](https://github.com/rubys/roundhouse/pull/705) repairs that join on main; the recorded staged pin predates the repair.
- With the `RH_DET` bundle, 59 new dispatch errors have receivers that are `nil` alone, where the source builds an object; source review judges 58 impossible and one unclear. A trace finds 52 of them come from permanent dispatch fallbacks, 7 from other inference gaps and none from a pending value (F18).
- In the `RH_DET` trial, `norm_opt` in `det.rs` drops a top-level `Var` arm as ⊥, so `Nil | Var` becomes `Nil` ([details](https://github.com/rubys/roundhouse/issues/617#issuecomment-6077674666)). Dispatch misses produce the same `Var(0)`, and keeping a `Var` that survives to quiescence as unresolved removes all 59, at a cost in precision (F18). On main, `strip_unknown(Nil | Var)` yields `Nil`; `stabilize_untyped_return_oscillation` can restore `Nil | untyped` when stripped cores match ([details](https://github.com/rubys/roundhouse/issues/617#issuecomment-6076645589), item 7).
- The settling reproduction shows that correct flow and settling are both needed. The October 9 rerun at main `1ce99695`, after [#634](https://github.com/rubys/roundhouse/pull/634), still settles but rejects 6 of 12 recorded values. With the flow fix, production reaches the cap and rejects none; absorb settles at zero-based round 9, whereas it reached the cap at the earlier `9b2dd5e9` pin (F17). These are pinned observations, not a check of live main.

## Leads

- The October 10 staged and next pins already include [#705](https://github.com/rubys/roundhouse/pull/705), yet F28/F29 still witness the earlier String omission on next `38403140`. Isolate the remaining cause and check a repair against the pinned app trace; the receipt does not attribute it to one rule.
- Until S2a's tag can tell producers apart, keeping a `Var` that survives to quiescence as unresolved avoids the recorded `nil`-only receivers ([proposed here](https://github.com/rubys/roundhouse/issues/617#issuecomment-6077674666)). The producer investigation and opt-in measurement are complete (F18): all 59 disappear, but fully typed falls to 64.01%, and 97 of 147 vanished errors are hidden. Model the missing dispatch behavior before claiming a precision or soundness gain. These producer witnesses are static analysis records, not app-runtime traces.
- Cover the interval-tick read at `app/jobs/base.rb:145:9`, then expand traces beyond this selected class and to other apps' own tests. Keep the fixed denominator and uncertain/unsupported census alongside membership while checking repairs (F29).
